translations.name: NJ Courts Ombudsman / Court User Resource Centers
translations.description: NJ Courts Ombudsman and Court User Resource Centers help anyone who uses the courts, including tenants and others with legal problems. Walk in, call or email, Monday to Friday 8:30am-4:30pm. Use your county's phone number, not the general call center.
translations.warning: Use your county's phone number, not the general call center.
translations.website_description: Learn about free or low-cost legal help.
